jobs.title: Senior GIS Specialist
jobs.description:
Department:
Imerza
Location:
Imerza

Description

Imerza is a global digital twin consultancy partnering with visionary placemakers - developers, architects, and brands - to visualize complex information and data across every stage of the development lifecycle. From concepting to closing and beyond, we deliver measurable value through immersive intelligence: transforming raw geospatial and project data into powerful, real-time 3D environments that drive better decisions.

Imerza is part of the Together Group - a collective of world-class creative and marketing agencies including Noe & Associates, Visualisation One, Purple, Construct, Folk at Purple, HotPot China, and North Six. Together Group brings together specialist expertise across branding, visualisation, communications, and digital experience, giving Imerza access to an unparalleled network of talent and resources to deliver transformative outcomes for clients globally.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and manage all GIS technical deliverables across multiple projects, ensuring timely, high-quality outputs aligned with client requirements and company standards.
- Oversee the full GIS workflow, from data acquisition and processing to final integration into immersive environments.
- Maintain strict adherence to standardised data structures, schemas, naming conventions, and metadata protocols for all geospatial datasets.
- Develop, implement, and enforce best-practice GIS data management policies to ensure consistency, accuracy, and scalability.
- Perform advanced geospatial data processing, cleaning, transformation, and quality assurance using ArcGIS, QGIS, or similar platforms.
- Prepare and optimise GIS datasets (vector, raster, elevation/DEM, 3D features, and attribute data) for ingestion into Unreal Engine.
- Utilise Unreal Engine tools and plugins (e.g. ArcGIS Maps SDK for Unreal Engine) to import, geo-reference, and integrate GIS data into real-time 3D environments and digital twins.
- Collaborate closely with Unreal Engine developers, 3D artists, and visualisation teams to troubleshoot geospatial integration issues (coordinate systems, scale, precision, performance optimisation).
- Ensure geospatial accuracy, coordinate reference system alignment, and visual fidelity when translating GIS data into Unreal Engine scenes.
- Manage version control, backups, and archiving of GIS datasets to support project iteration and long-term asset reuse.
- Document GIS processes, data pipelines, and Unreal Engine ingestion workflows to facilitate team knowledge sharing and onboarding.
- Identify and implement opportunities to automate GIS-to-Unreal data pipelines for increased efficiency on large-scale projects.
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior GIS team members on data standards, Unreal integration techniques, and project-specific requirements.
- Research and source GIS datasets to support world-building teams.
- Stay current with advancements in GIS technologies, game-engine geospatial tools, and emerging best practices for immersive digital twin development.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required:

- Proven senior-level experience in GIS data management, processing, and analysis.
- Deep proficiency with ArcGIS, QGIS, or comparable GIS platforms.
- Hands-on experience integrating GIS data into Unreal Engine, including familiarity with the ArcGIS Maps SDK for Unreal Engine or similar geospatial game-engine plugins.
- Strong understanding of coordinate reference systems, projections, and geospatial accuracy requirements.
- Experience preparing and optimising vector, raster, DEM/elevation, and 3D feature datasets for real-time 3D environments.
- Ability to develop and enforce data standards, schemas, and documentation across teams.
- Experience with pipeline automation and scripting (Python or similar) for GIS data workflows.
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills
- comfortable working cross-functionally with 3D artists, developers, and project managers.
- Experience managing and mentoring junior team members.

Nice to Have:

- Background in real estate, architecture, urban planning, or related property development industries.
- Familiarity with digital twin platforms and immersive visualisation pipelines.
- Experience with game engines beyond Unreal Engine (e.g. Unity).
- Knowledge of BIM data and its integration with GIS environments.

What We Offer

- A globally distributed, collaborative team at the cutting edge of immersive technology.
- Exposure to high-profile, visionary real estate and placemaking projects worldwide.
- The opportunity to shape GIS best practices and build scalable workflows in an innovative, fast-growing consultancy.
- Flexible, remote-first working environment.

jobs.title: MIS Product Configurator and Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Title:
MIS Product Configurator and Data Analyst
Location:
On Site - Los Angeles, California, United States
Salary:
$75000-$130000
Skills:
CIS Configurator, SAP Business One, SQL, Manufacturing BOMs, Data Modeling

About the Manufacturing Company / The Opportunity:

Join an innovative leader in the building supply manufacturing industry that is modernizing its production and data platforms. This is a pivotal opportunity to architect and optimize the translation of complex door configurations into seamless system logic, working alongside skilled teams at the forefront of technology transformation. Make a direct impact on efficiency and product delivery by shaping advanced ERP and manufacturing systems in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

Responsibilities:

Translate manufacturing requirements and sales/pricing rules into precise system logic using the CIS Configurator for a diverse range of SKUs and entry door products.
Develop and maintain advanced configuration models, dimensional and handing logic, and dependency rules for components, pricing structures, and compatibility mapping.
Oversee item masters and multi-level Bills of Materials (BOMs) in SAP Business One, ensuring execution layer data integrity and “single source of truth” for production and procurement processes.
Define operation sequences, maintain standard routing data, and ensure detailed scheduling for on-time delivery within MES and APS systems (LYNQ, WiSys).
Lead system validation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and proactively audit order-to-cash process flows to guarantee error-free production.
Extract legacy knowledge from legacy systems (AS/400 Friedman), translating manual processes into standardized, automated solutions for SAP B1 and CIS.
Utilize SQL and advanced Excel for margin validation, root-cause analysis, and ongoing auditing of production schedule accuracy.
Support, monitor, and troubleshoot EDI and API-based integrations connecting core platforms (ERP, MES, WMS), and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for configuration logic.

Must-Have Skills:

Minimum 5 years’ experience in manufacturing systems, with emphasis on product structures, multi-level Bills of Materials (BOMs), and routings.
Hands-on expertise with CIS Configurator or similar rules-based CPQ software, and proficiency in SAP Business One ERP.
Strong SQL skills for data modeling, technical troubleshooting, and cross-platform integration.
Advanced Excel skills for auditing and margin analysis.
Proven ability to translate manufacturing and sales requirements into system logic and configuration models.
Exceptional attention to detail and a “zero-error” approach to data entry and systems maintenance.
Effective communicator with experience bridging Sales, Engineering, and Shop-Floor Operations.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

Experience supporting or monitoring EDI, API-based integrations, or middleware between ERP and MES systems.
Familiarity with the AS/400 Friedman system or legacy-to-modern system migration projects.
Direct experience configuring, maintaining, or integrating LYNQ MES and WiSys WMS platforms.
Background in documenting technical knowledge and developing SOPs for complex manufacturing rules.
Exposure to discrete manufacturing environments involving highly customizable or configured-to-order products.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Job function

Analyst and Manufacturing

Industries

Furniture and Home Furnishings Manufacturing

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Description
This role is for a Junior Data Analyst responsible for supporting data-driven decision-making through data collection, analysis, validation, and reporting. In this position, you will assist in transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support business operations, performance monitoring, and strategic initiatives.
As a Junior Data Analyst, you will work with datasets from multiple sources, helping to clean, organize, and prepare data for analysis. You will support senior analysts or cross-functional teams by performing structured analyses, identifying basic trends and patterns, and ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
Key responsibilities include maintaining datasets, performing data validation checks, and assisting with routine analytical tasks. You will help generate reports, dashboards, and summaries that communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You will collaborate with teams across departments to understand data requirements, support reporting needs, and contribute to ongoing analytics projects. This role provides exposure to real-world data workflows, business metrics, and analytical processes, making it ideal for individuals looking to develop foundational data analysis skills.
The Junior Data Analyst role requires strong attention to detail, logical thinking, and a willingness to learn. You will be expected to follow data standards, document assumptions, and ensure that outputs are accurate, timely, and aligned with business objectives.
Clear communication skills are important, as you will assist in explaining data findings and supporting informed decision-making. By providing reliable analytical support, the Junior Data Analyst plays an important role in enabling data-driven insights and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple sources
Perform basic data analysis to identify trends and patterns
Validate data accuracy and consistency
Maintain and update datasets and data documentation
Assist in creating reports, dashboards, and summaries
Support ad-hoc data requests and routine analytical tasks
Collaborate with analysts and stakeholders on data requirements
Document methodologies, assumptions, and data sources
Support performance tracking and operational reporting
Follow data quality and governance standards

Qualifications
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
High attention to detail and data accuracy
Ability to work with structured datasets
Proficiency with spreadsheets and basic analysis tools
Basic understanding of data analysis concepts and metrics
Ability to create clear reports and summaries
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
Willingness to learn and develop analytical skills
Educational background in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred

Entry level

jobs.title: Manufacturing Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Employment Status:
Full-Time, Salaried/Exempt

Location:
Waukegan, IL

Schedule:
Onsite daily Monday through Friday from 8 am – 5 pm CT.

Salary:
$75,000 - $95,000

Position Overview

The Manufacturing Data Analyst will enhance supply chain and manufacturing performance through data-driven insights, SIOP reporting, forecasting support, inventory analysis, ERP data validation, and operational KPI reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver accurate and timely business intelligence to support Supply Chain, SIOP, planning, and manufacturing operations.
Develop and maintain reports and dashboards related to forecast accuracy, inventory health, supplier performance, production efficiency, and operational KPIs.
Own SIOP data tracking and provide weekly and monthly updates that highlight gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities.
Partner with Planning, Commercial, Operations, Purchasing, and Finance teams to align demand forecasts with operational capabilities.
Maintain and improve databases, data models, and reporting tools that support proactive decision-making.
Analyze historical data to identify trends, variances, risks, and improvement areas in production planning and material availability.
Validate ERP data, including routings and BOMs, and act as a gatekeeper for master data changes.
Support monthly forecasting, scenario planning, benchmarking, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Management, or equivalent work experience.
5 years of experience in supply chain or manufacturing operations with a focus on data analysis, forecasting, and strategic business operations.
2 years of experience directly supporting or managing Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning (SIOP).
Advanced Excel skills, including VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, Power Query, SUMIFs, and related functions.
Experience with ERP/MRP systems such as Microsoft Navision or similar platforms.
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other visualization tools preferred.
Experience with forecasting and trend analysis tools or methods, including time series and regression models.
Strong ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for cross-functional stakeholders.

Physical Requirements

Ability to lift up to 15 pounds at a time.
Ability to sit for prolonged periods while working at a computer.
Ability to work in a traditional office setting with normal noise levels.
Ability to view a computer screen for extended periods and review detailed data.

Benefits

The company offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k), paid maternity leave, paid paternity leave, tuition assistance, disability insurance, paid time off and holidays, and additional wellness and lifestyle benefits.
